{{Top|leg}}
An '''ID overlay''' was a device that broadcast a signal informing other [[Starship/Legends|ships]] that the vessel carrying it was friendly. In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Crev Bombaasa/Legends|Crev Bombaasa]] supplied an ID overlay to the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Talon Karrde]] so that the ''[[Wild Karrde]]'' would be able to pass through Bombaasa's territory safely.
